answer: Problem: Sybil clones flood peer panels and dilute attestation weight. Mechanism: each new identity must finish a 48-hour voyage of three timed work receipts (min 900s apart) before seat eligibility; receipts hash into walnut escrow key H(pubkey||epoch||slot). Cost: ~0.12 POA locked per clone plus irreversible time, so N clones need N calendars. Verification: panelists recompute the vertex of the three receipt hashes vs the escrow map and reject reuse. Failure: missing slot gap, reused walnut key, or incomplete voyage zeroes weight that epoch.
